payload.words: A Goal in work runs on newer code than its H0 only when every example measures the same there, and the owner sees each move that was refused and why.

lines.text: A run of an open Goal on a commit that holds code newer than H0 is accepted when every example gives the same floors and ceilings on that commit's base as on H0.
A run on a commit whose base gives an example a different floor or ceiling than H0 is refused, and the refusal names the example, what differs, and the base commit.
After a refused move, hyp status G lists it among what waits for the owner, and the Goal stays in work on its old base.
A selected Goal accepts a run on a merge above its selected commit; when that merge is met on every line, hyp status G shows the Goal selected on it.
The PR body of a selected Goal names the base its select was measured against, and each example's result on that base and on the select.
Measuring a new base uses none of the Goal's three runs.
When an example measures differently on a new base and also differs from its record on the old base, the refusal says the environment changed, not the code.

why: #432 part 1: a Goal moves onto newer code when nothing it measures changed; owner decisions in #432 comment 7233635810
